Supply centres of a board or a game

Source: R/map.R, R/scobench.R
dp_supply_centres.Rd

For a dp_map this lists the 34 supply centres of the board. For a dp_game it additionally reports the current owner of each centre and whether it is occupied.

Usage

dp_supply_centres(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'dp_map'
dp_supply_centres(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'dp_game'
dp_supply_centres(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A dp_map or dp_game object.

...

Passed to methods.

Value

A tibble. For a map: centre, name, home_power. For a game: centre, name, home_power, owner, occupied_by.

See also

Other analysis: as_tibble.dp_history(), dp_history(), dp_history-class, dp_history_append(), dp_power_counts(), dp_power_summary(), dp_sc_trajectory(), dp_victory_check(), is_dp_history()

Examples

dp_supply_centres(dp_map())
#> # A tibble: 34 × 3
#>    centre name           home_power
#>    <chr>  <chr>          <chr>     
#>  1 ank    Ankara         Turkey    
#>  2 bel    Belgium        NA        
#>  3 ber    Berlin         Germany   
#>  4 bre    Brest          France    
#>  5 bud    Budapest       Austria   
#>  6 bul    Bulgaria       NA        
#>  7 con    Constantinople Turkey    
#>  8 den    Denmark        NA        
#>  9 edi    Edinburgh      England   
#> 10 gre    Greece         NA        
#> # ℹ 24 more rows
dp_supply_centres(dp_new_game())
#> # A tibble: 34 × 5
#>    centre name           home_power owner   occupied_by
#>    <chr>  <chr>          <chr>      <chr>   <chr>      
#>  1 ank    Ankara         Turkey     Turkey  Turkey     
#>  2 bel    Belgium        NA         NA      NA         
#>  3 ber    Berlin         Germany    Germany Germany    
#>  4 bre    Brest          France     France  France     
#>  5 bud    Budapest       Austria    Austria Austria    
#>  6 bul    Bulgaria       NA         NA      NA         
#>  7 con    Constantinople Turkey     Turkey  Turkey     
#>  8 den    Denmark        NA         NA      NA         
#>  9 edi    Edinburgh      England    England England    
#> 10 gre    Greece         NA         NA      NA         
#> # ℹ 24 more rows
